title: feat: implement V2-BE-064/066/067/068 - auth, audit, authorization, env validation
head: phertyameen:feature/phertyameen-auth-audit-config
body:
Implements the following issues:

- **Closes #415** (V2-BE-064): Rotate and Revoke Authentication Sessions
  - Enhanced TokenService with session tracking, device info, concurrent session limits
  - Added selective session revocation, revoke other sessions, session stats
  - Improved refresh token rotation with device info updates
  - Added session activity tracking and cleanup

- **Closes #417** (V2-BE-066): Enforce Least-Privilege API Authorization Policies
  - Created AuthorizationPolicyService with deny-by-default policies
  - Role-based access control for all resource types (claims, disputes, users, wallets, config, contracts, audit logs, metrics)
  - Support for ownership, role, scope, time, IP, and custom conditions
  - NestJS AuthorizationGuard and decorators (@RequirePermission, @RequireRoles)
  - Default policies for SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, MODERATOR, ANALYST, SUPPORT, USER, SERVICE

- **Closes #418** (V2-BE-067): Create a Tamper-Evident Administrative Audit Log
  - Created AdminAuditService with chained integrity hashing
  - Records actor, action, target, reason, request correlation, before/after digest, outcome
  - Supports all admin action types (user mgmt, wallet mgmt, claim/dispute moderation, config, contracts, system, security)
  - Tamper-evident via SHA-256 hash chaining

- **Closes #419** (V2-BE-068): Validate Secrets and Environment Configuration at Startup
  - Created EnvironmentValidationService running on module init
  - Validates required secrets (DB, auth, SIWE, blockchain, Redis, IPFS)
  - Rejects placeholder values and weak secrets
  - Validates chain/address combinations and rate limiting config
  - Redacts sensitive values in logs
  - Integrated into bootstrap sequence
